units.poolKey: COMBINATION C4: a low rung on a working approach
units.spine: The roads into the town are well used and the place they lead to is poor.

units.poolKey: INCOME MIX: one source carries the town
units.spine: One line of work brings in what money the town has, and a household with no part in it lives off it all the same.

units.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
units.spine: What leaves the town and what comes into it are carried on the same carts.
Warmholz sells several things outward and none of them carries the trade alone.
This place feeds itself and has a little in hand.
The salt worked here is bought and never raised, and the buying is as much a part of the craft as the working.
